items.finding: The definition of Confidential Information is mutual and covers information disclosed by either party, specifically including Mr. Ortiz's rates and proprietary tools.
items.quote: "Confidential Information" means any non-public information disclosed by one Party (the "Disclosing Party") to the other (the "Receiving Party") in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is marked or identified as confidential or that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential, including business plans, client names and project details, pricing, source code, technical designs, and (in the case of Mr. Ortiz) his rates and proprietary tools.

items.finding: The exception allowing disclosure to affiliates, employees, and professional advisers is asymmetric and is granted only to AtliQ.
items.quote: not disclose it to any third party except, in AtliQ's case, to its Affiliates, employees and professional advisers with a need to know who are bound by confidentiality obligations no less protective than this Agreement;
items.counterPosition: The exception allowing disclosure to employees, professional advisers, and representatives on a need-to-know basis should be made fully mutual for both Parties.

items.finding: The agreement does not contain a residuals clause, which protects both parties from unauthorized retention of mental impressions.
Remedies are mutual, allowing each party to seek injunctive relief in addition to other remedies, with no lopsided indemnities or liability caps.
items.quote: Each Party may seek injunctive relief for any actual or threatened breach of this Agreement, in addition to any other remedy.

items.finding: The agreement contains no hidden non-compete, non-solicit, or exclusivity covenants.
The term is mutual and reasonable, with a two-year disclosure period and a three-year survival period for the obligations.
items.quote: This Agreement applies to information disclosed during the two (2) years following the Effective Date. The obligations in Sections 3 and 4 continue for three (3) years after the end of that period.
